slice: groupssor.com API — latest-500 only, re-poll for new submissions since Nov 8
notes: API returned HTTP 200, fixed 500 entries (ignores limit/page params; limit=1000 still 500, page=2 timed out). Newest entry 2026-11-08T19:28:51Z; no submissions newer than that in this poll. Slow-verified 93 via curl (max 3 parallel, >=0.5s spacing; ambiguous 200+empty-og:title retried up to 3 attempts). All 93 returned HTTP 200 — dead links also return 200 with empty og:title, so dead=84 (empty title after 3 attempts), live=9. Post-screen on og:title dropped 1 live link (J6yVkaaOraRGBnzYLxuApi, og:title adult 🔞🍑 despite clean listing name). Final candidates=8, ALL created 2026-11-08; older fresh entries were almost all dead. Pending=0 (no transport failures). Verification was slow (~40 min) — many other wave teams were hitting chat.whatsapp.com concurrently.
